headline.zh: Primia 如何连接遗留系统与 AI 代理
headline.en: How Primia Connects Legacy Systems to AI Agents

scenario.zh: 企业选择一个遗留系统，Primia 为其搭建 AI 代理集成层
scenario.en: Pick a legacy system; see how Primia bridges it to an AI agent layer

instruction.zh: 选择你的场景，查看 Primia 如何为其建立集成
instruction.en: Pick your scenario to see how Primia builds the integration

output.zh: Primia 将 ERP 库存数据暴露为标准化接口，供 AI 代理查询
output.en: Primia exposes ERP inventory data via a normalized interface for AI agents to query

input.zh:
ERP 系统：SAP R/3（遗留版本）
数据源：库存模块
连接方式：Primia 适配器
input.en:
ERP: SAP R/3 (legacy version)
Data source: inventory module
Connector: Primia adapter

output.zh: 代理可查询库存水位、触发补货请求、读取供应商交货记录
output.en: Agent can query stock levels, trigger reorder requests, read supplier delivery records

detail.zh: Primia 适配器映射 SAP R/3 的遗留 BAPI 接口至标准 API 格式
detail.en: Primia adapter maps legacy SAP R/3 BAPI calls to a standard API format

detail.zh: 库存查询、补货触发等操作注册为代理可调用工具
detail.en: Stock query and reorder trigger registered as callable agent tools

detail.zh: 代理只能读取库存与供应商数据，不可修改财务记录
detail.en: Agent can read inventory and supplier data; financial records remain out of scope

output.zh: Primia 将会员数据库接入 AI 代理，支持续费提醒与流失预测
output.en: Primia connects the membership database to an AI agent for renewal alerts and churn signals

input.zh:
CRM 系统：定制遗留数据库（SQL Server 2008）
数据源：会员档案、到访记录
连接方式：Primia 适配器
input.en:
CRM: custom legacy database (SQL Server 2008)
Data source: member profiles, visit logs
Connector: Primia adapter

output.zh: 代理可识别连续未到访会员、生成续费提醒列表、标记高流失风险账户
output.en: Agent can identify inactive members, generate renewal reminder lists, flag high-churn accounts

detail.zh: Primia 将非结构化遗留字段映射为统一会员数据模型
detail.en: Primia maps unstructured legacy fields to a unified member data model

detail.zh: 流失检测与提醒生成注册为代理可触发的自动化任务
detail.en: Churn detection and reminder generation registered as agent-triggered automations

detail.zh: 代理可读取行为数据，不可修改会员合同或支付信息
detail.en: Agent can read behavioral data; contract and payment info remain out of scope

title.en: What Task Does the Agent Run

instruction.zh: 选择代理的核心工作，查看输入与输出示例
instruction.en: Choose the agent's core job to see an input/output example

output.zh: 代理持续轮询遗留系统，标记异常并生成摘要报告
output.en: Agent polls the legacy system continuously, flags anomalies, and produces a summary report

input_label.zh: 遗留系统数据片段（虚构）

input.zh:
仓库 A 库存：螺旋桨部件 12 件（正常阈值：≥50）
仓库 B 库存：螺旋桨部件 487 件
上次补货日期：43 天前
input.en:
Warehouse A stock: propeller parts 12 units (normal threshold: ≥50)
Warehouse B stock: propeller parts 487 units
Last reorder: 43 days ago

output.zh: 异常标记：仓库 A 库存严重偏低，建议触发补货；仓库 B 库存过剩，建议暂缓采购
output.en: Anomaly flagged: Warehouse A critically low — reorder suggested; Warehouse B overstocked — pause procurement

output.zh: 代理从多个遗留系统拉取数据，合并为统一视图供决策层使用
output.en: Agent pulls from multiple legacy systems and merges data into a unified view for decision-makers

input.zh:
ERP：会员 #4471 消费记录 ✓
CRM：会员 #4471 到访记录 ✓
营销系统：会员 #4471 活动参与 ✗（无法访问）
input.en:
ERP: Member #4471 spend history ✓
CRM: Member #4471 visit logs ✓
Marketing: Member #4471 campaign engagement ✗ (inaccessible)

output.zh: 会员 #4471：高消费、低到访、未参与近期活动 → 流失风险：高
output.en: Member #4471: high spend, low visits, no recent campaign engagement → Churn risk: high

takeaway.zh: 示例说明了 Primia 的集成层概念；具体能力与系统支持范围请在 primero.com 核实
takeaway.en: Examples illustrate Primia's integration layer concept; verify supported systems and capabilities at primero.com
